newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commercials, exports.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commercials, exports.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on commercial, commission and export demand, traders said.

"PCTS legged 100 March-May, Cargill legged 10 May-July and RBC-DS bought the March," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin fell to -23.52 from -21.02 Friday based on CBOT soyoil and meal. March-May spread at $1.50. Volume was 860.
Japan bought 2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola rose $2.50 to $407.10, May up $2.80 to $405.90. March flax fell $0.20 to $345.50 on commercial selling, five hedges. May-July spread at $2.
Oats and peas did not trade.
February western barley fell $0.20 to $135.80 on commercial liquidation in thin trade on holidays in Alberta and the United States. Feb-March spread $1.30. Volume was 150.
March feed wheat lost $1.30 to $164.70 on commercial selling, May fell $0.20 to $162.50. March-May spread $2.70. Volume was 500 lots.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
